en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street with large chestnut trees and a straight avenue stretching into the distance. At the entrance of the street stand two stone gate pillars crowned with sculptures, flanking the roadway. On the right is a villa or mansion with a square tower and ornate roof details behind a wooden fence. A single person stands in the middle of the street. The caption is printed at the top in red text.
